title: AGDecode: Semantic Attribute Grammar Derivatives for Safety-Constrained Decoding of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.36105v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, motivating techniques that guarantee the structural and semantic correctness of generated programs. Constrained decoding enforces correctness during generation by restricting token choices to those that admit at least one valid completion. While existing approaches can enforce syntactic constraints and selected semantic properties such as type safety, they either target specific properties or rely on operational pruning mechanisms that are difficult to generalize to data-dependent, inductive program properties. We present AGDecode, a programmable framework for semantic constrained decoding based on least-fixed-point semantics. AGDecode extends attribute grammars to partially constructed syntax trees, and reduces semantic constrained decoding to a realizability problem over such trees. The framework compiles semantic specifications into systems of relational constrain

translated_title: AGDecode：用于大语言模型安全约束解码的语义属性文法导数
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于代码生成，这促使人们研究能够保证所生成程序结构与语义正确性的技术。约束解码通过在生成过程中将词元选择限制在至少存在一个有效补全的选项上，从而强制保证正确性。虽然现有方法可以强制执行句法约束以及某些选定的语义属性（如类型安全），但它们要么只针对特定属性，要么依赖于难以推广到数据相关、归纳性程序属性的操作性剪枝机制。我们提出了AGDecode，一个基于最小不动点语义的可编程语义约束解码框架。AGDecode将属性文法扩展到部分构造的语法树上，并将语义约束解码归约为这类树上的可实现性问题。该框架将语义规范编译为关系约束系统（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: AGDecode提出了一种基于最小不动点语义的可编程语义约束解码框架，通过将属性文法扩展到部分构造的语法树并把语义约束解码归约为可实现性问题，从而保证大语言模型所生成程序的结构与语义正确性。
en_tdlr: AGDecode is a programmable semantic constrained decoding framework based on least-fixed-point semantics that extends attribute grammars to partially constructed syntax trees and reduces semantic constrained decoding to a realizability problem, thereby guaranteeing the structural and semantic correctness of LLM-generated programs.
